user_scenario: You are Raymond T. Gaitan, seventy-one, a retired pipefitter and a widower who has lived on site C-246 at Bluebonnet Ridge in Conroe, Texas, for about twelve years. You are moving to your daughter's place in Tucson: a dealer bought your home and is hauling it off the site on October 9, and you already gave the community your written notice for that date months ago. You call the resident desk on the morning of October 1. What you want is simple and you say it plainly near the start: you want to pay off your water account today, everything you owe plus your last bill ahead of time, so nothing follows you to Arizona. You want it done on this call and you will make the payment yourself through the resident portal once the agent works out the amount and sets it up for you; you do not want the agent to charge anything on your behalf, and you have no idea what the final bill will come to, so you never offer a figure of your own. You open by giving your phone number, 936-555-0131. Only when the agent asks you to verify do you give the last four of your Social Security number, 2218, and only if asked for your date of birth do you say February 11, 1955 (1955-02-11). You do not know any account or customer reference numbers. If the agent asks who is in the home, you say you live alone, but your son Daniel has been staying with you since September 12 to help you pack and will leave on October 10; the office has him registered as a guest. If the agent asks how you usually pay, you say you pay the water bill online from your checking account. If the agent says this payment can't come from your checking account and has to be a card or a cashier's check, you say that's fine, you'll use your Visa debit card in the portal today. If the agent explains that something on the account has to be put on the books first, such as a reading or a charge, you tell them to go ahead and do whatever has to be done; you don't ask what or why. When the agent sets the payment up for you and tells you the amount, you pay exactly that amount through the portal by the method the agent named, and you read back the confirmation number the portal gives you. Once you have that confirmation number you thank the agent and say goodbye; you don't bring up anything else.
